compiled_state.title: Complete Jira reconciler — implement inbound leaves + cap routing + validation-class obligation tracking
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Why

Epic 4047 (Derivable level-triggered Jira reconciler) closed P1=PASS across all 11 stories on 2026-05-25, but a 2026-05-26 attempted live-verification revealed the load-bearing implementation is no-op scaffolding. The reconciler runs end-to-end without crashes (after the bug f6cc / defect chain was fixed) but every inbound mutation flows through stub applier leaves that return empty `ApplyResult` without writing anything. Mode→cap routing is validated at entry but never threaded to the apply step. Bug 1761-21ca-cb74-44a6 captures the planning/decomposition machinery that produced this — its remediation candidates are applied by hand throughout this epic to avoid reproducing the same pattern.

## Scope

Complete the reconciler so that:
- All 7 inbound `(direction, action)` leaves perform their documented behavior (5 unimplemented today + 1 dead-code + 1 already-working).
- The 4-mode rollout machinery (dry-run / bootstrap-strict / bootstrap-throttle / live) actually enforces per-mode mutation caps and emits asymmetric manifests per mode.
- The completion-verifier toolchain refuses to accept "deferred to operator execution" as DD satisfaction without producing a tracked obligation ticket (the bug 1761 fix — applied to ourselves).
- The live DIG project is bootstrapped through Phase 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 with operator-committed phase-gate transitions and rollback validation.

## Out of scope

- Per-element-class round-trip idempotency for ALL collection types — Story 4 exercises the round-trip path on representative classes (comments, labels, links); broader element-class coverage is a follow-on.
- Cross-project reconciler operation (DIG is the only project today).
- ACLI version upgrades.

## Constraints (lessons from bug 1761 applied by hand)

Every story DD MUST:
1. Pair a shape clause with a behavior clause ("function exists" + "produces observable file/state change Z").
2. Name the dispatch path explicitly when referencing a leaf/handler/router (e.g., `_LEAVES[(inbound, create)]`).
3. Enumerate every function body that must be implemented.
4. Refuse \"deferred to operator execution\" as a closure path UNLESS the deferral creates an obligation ticket via Story 3's mechanism with deadline + owner + validation command.

Every task list under a story MUST produce ≥1 task per function body named in the Done Definitions.

## Success Criteria (live-verified, with tracked obligations)

1. After Phase 0 dispatch on main, `ticket list --tag=imported:reconciler-bootstrap` returns zero tickets (cap=0 honored). Tracked obligation: Phase 0 dispatch within 7 days of Story 1+2 merge.
2. After Phase 1 dispatch (5 passes), `ticket list --tag=imported:reconciler-bootstrap` returns exactly 50 tickets. Tracked obligation per pass.
3. After Phase 2 dispatch (3 passes), `ticket list --tag=imported:reconciler-bootstrap` returns exactly 350 tickets cumulatively. Tracked obligation per pass.
4. After Phase 3 enablement, 5 consecutive scheduled cron runs each emit a manifest with ≤5 mutations. Tracked obligation: monitor for 7 days after Phase 3 enable.
5. Bridge-fsck label-only-orphan count drops from 197 (at Phase 1 start) to 0 (at Phase 2 end). Tracked obligation: capture both counts.
6. `_LEAVES` registry structural coverage test passes: every entry resolves to a function with ≥10 effective code lines OR contains a state-changing call. CI gate, NOT operator-deferred.
7. Mode→cap behavioral test passes: dispatching `mode=bootstrap-strict` against a 2050-mutation fixture produces a manifest with exactly 10 applied + 2040 deferred. CI gate, NOT operator-deferred.

## Closure Checks

- All 4 child stories closed P1=PASS via the new completion-verifier protocol (Story 3 extension).
- All Phase 0/1/2/3 obligation tickets discharged (closed with evidence) OR explicitly rolled into a follow-on epic with operator sign-off.
- `_LEAVES` registry coverage test in CI; passing.
- `rollback-phase-1.sh` exercised against a fixture and producing the documented teardown.

## Relates to

- relates_to bug f6cc-b174-9e9a-435c (specific 1000-ceiling instance — already fixed)
- relates_to bug 1761-21ca-cb74-44a6 (decomposition meta-bug — this epic applies its remediation by hand AND ships Story 3 as the toolchain fix)
- relates_to bug 5f2a-9a9f-2b4a-4aab (production-only defect cluster — its chain motivated this work)
- relates_to epic 4047-3cb1-6cb4-46a1 (the closed-incomplete epic this completes)
